I am a computational biology PhD student with [Prof. Julien Gagneur](https://www.professoren.tum.de/en/gagneur-julien) at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and Helmholtz Munich. I'm curious about how rare genetic variants influence complex traits and diseases, and I explore these questions using large biomedical datasets like the UK Biobank and Solve-RD.

In summer 2026 I spent three months at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard with [Hilary Finucane](https://www.finucanelab.org) and [Konrad Karczewski](https://konradjk.github.io), funded by an EMBO Scientific Exchange Grant.

Previously, I completed my Bachelor's and Master's in Science at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune, in India.

## Highlighted work

- **Phenotypes of ultra-rare variant carriers benchmark variant effect scores.** bioRxiv, 2026. [Preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.10.01.755962v1) · [Code](https://github.com/gagneurlab/ukbbgym)
- **Functional gene embeddings improve rare variant polygenic risk scores.** bioRxiv, 2024. [Preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.07.22.604535v3) · [Code](https://github.com/gagneurlab/funcRVP)
